caption: Anatomy of a Low Earth Orbit pass: the satellite rises above your horizon (AOS), climbs overhead, and sets (LOS) — a roughly 10-minute window out of an orbit of about 100 minutes, worked on separate uplink and downlink frequencies.
spoken: A ground station under the arc of a satellite pass: the satellite rises at AOS, passes overhead exchanging uplink and downlink signals on different frequencies, and sets at LOS. A low Earth orbit takes about 100 minutes.
